label: Steady open first law
text: EN.O.A3.1.1 Steady open-system first law: Q̇ − Ẇ = Σṁ(h + V²/2 + g z)out − Σṁ(h + V²/2 + g z)in, with heat in and work out positive. The law is owned by physics (uses PH.O.A4.1).

warrant.standard: Energy balance closes within measurement uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Extrapolated correlation; non-equilibrium; wrong dead state
